onboarding.voiceWelcome: Woezɔ ɖe SafePay. Èle aƒe me ɖe. Zi Speak Balance zi eve be nàse wò ga, alo zã MoMo dɔwɔɖoɖoawo.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Woezɔ ɖe SafePay. SafePay gblɔ wo ga na wò, eye wò PIN meƒo o. Ɖoɖo sia didi aɖeke mele o. Zã wò gbe alo wò ŋusẽ.
onboarding.micBody: Wòaxɔ microphone ɖe? SafePay kpɔa nusiwo gblɔm le app la me, eye nèade ahyɛde vevewo gblɔ.
onboarding.micGranted: Microphone la xɔ ɖe. SafePay ate ŋu akpɔ wò gbe.
onboarding.micDenied: Mava o. Emegbe nàxoe ɖe le Settings me.
onboarding.micPermanent: Microphone la tutu ɖe SafePay ta. Ɖoe le wò fono ƒe settings me, eye trɔ bu SafePay.
onboarding.listeningBody: Ne SafePay le eme la, microphone la li ɖaa. Mele be nàdia bɔtɔn o. Gblɔ dzo ɖa alo stop, be SafePay nawɔ kokoko.
onboarding.nextHint: Zi eve be ye yi fifi si kplɔe ɖe
onboarding.skipHint: Zi eve be nàtrɔ fifi sia
onboarding.contactsBody: Emegbe, neègblɔ ame ŋkɔ, SafePay ate ŋu adze eƒe fono nɔmbra. Gbegbe gbãtɔ si nàzãe la, èabià wò ŋusẽ. Wò contacts nɔ wo fono me ko.
onboarding.talkbackTitle: Nèzɔa ɖe ɖe screen la dzi ɖe?
onboarding.talkbackBody: Nèzɔa ɖe ɖe screen la dzi ɖe?
onboarding.srOff: Wò screen reader mele eme o. SafePay aku eƒe gbe ɖe.
onboarding.micTestBody: Gblɔ nu ɖeka ɖe. Le le: SafePay, nùkwɔm?
onboarding.micTestRetry: Mesese nu o. Gbugbɔ gblɔ, kpe ɖe edzi.
onboarding.voiceTestOk: Ɛyɛ. Nàte ŋu akpɔ akesi ɖa ɣesiaɣi.
onboarding.voiceTestNo: Kpɔ akesi ƒe lolome ɖe edzi, eye nègbugbɔ se.
onboarding.bioBody: SafePay ɖe asi na gaɖoɖo bliboe kple wò ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi. Wò PIN meƒo o.
onboarding.bioTest: Sɔ ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi la ɖo
onboarding.bioReady: Wò ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi le dɔm.
onboarding.bioNone: Fono sia mele ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi o. SafePay azã wò gbe ɖe asi.
onboarding.bioNotEnrolled: Wò ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi mele ɖoɖo nu o. Nàde eme le fono ƒe settings, Security te. Va se ɖe eme la, SafePay azã wò gbe.
onboarding.bioSuccess: Ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi la ɖe asi. Wò ga me tsi tre ɖe o.
onboarding.bioFailed: Ŋusẽ me ŋkuɖodzi la meɖe asi o. Nàte ŋu agbugbɔ ɖo ɣesiaɣi.
onboarding.bioLockout: Ɖodze akpaa dodo. Nànɔ eme kakra.
onboarding.teachBody: Ahyɛde etɔ̃. Gblɔ be: nye ga, nàse wò ga. Gblɔ be: ɖo ga, nàɖo ga. Gblɔ be: dzo ɖa, be SafePay nawɔ kokoko.
onboarding.teachBalance: Ɛ̃! Nye ga nye ga ƒe ahyɛde.
onboarding.teachSend: Ɛ̃! Ɖo ga nye gaɖoɖo ƒe ahyɛde.
onboarding.teachStop: Ɛ̃! Dzo ɖa na SafePay nawɔ kokoko.
onboarding.teachAgain: Gbugbɔ ɖo. Ahyɛdeawo nye: nye ga, ɖo ga, dzo ɖa.
onboarding.doneBody: SafePay ƒe ɖoɖo du ɖe. Nàse wò ga kple ga ƒe ŋkɔkɔ, eye wò PIN meƒo o. Gblɔ nye ga, nàse wò ga.
onboarding.exited: Ɖoɖo la gbe ɖe. Àgagbɔ ɖo le Settings me.
